title: Bormioli Luigi unveils Indue, the first dual-compartment glass bottle
summary: Designed for formulations mixed at the time of application, dual-chamber bottles have so far been available only in plastic. Bormioli Luigi is now introducing a glass version, bringing an added dimension of luxury to the format. Unveiled at Luxe Pack Monaco 2026, held September 28–30, the Indue concept is paired with a dispensing pump developed by Aptar Beauty.
